name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; descriptor accurately reflects the behavior (wait for key while repainting the settings/options dialog background+borders). Sibling of the other fd2_wait_input_with_*_repaint loops in input.c. No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Idle/repaint loop driven while a settings/options dialog is open: busy-waits for any keyboard input while compositing the battle background, characters, terrain HUD and animated dialog borders each frame, then reads the key via INT 16h and remaps extended scancodes before returning the scancode.
logic_summary: while (keyboard buffer empty): advance palette cycle anim; if (BIOS_tick - oscillator_tick_latch) > 3 OR < 0 (rollover): bump dialog blink-phase oscillator with 0<->1 wrap and re-latch the tick; tick chapter palette anim; composite battle tile-map into game_state_buf+0x8088, composite all-chars overlay, render terrain HUD panel, repaint settings dialog borders (menu_state, pSlot_disable_arr), blit composite buffer to mode13h front buffer at 0xA0504. On key arrival: set key_input_mode=0x10, int386(0x16) read enhanced keyboard; remap E0/0x52(Down)->0x1C(Enter), 0x53(Right)->0x01(Esc); return key_input_mode (scancode).

params.name: menu_state
params.semantics: Opaque menu/drawing-state context; not used by the repaint loop itself, passed straight through to fd2_repaint_settings_dialog_borders. Supplied by the sole caller fd2_settings_menu_input_step from its own menu_state argument.
params.reason: Descriptive, no address residue; accurately names the pass-through menu state consumed by the border repaint.

params.name: pSlot_disable_arr
params.semantics: Pointer (passed as uint) to the caller's int[4] per-direction slot-disable array (index 0=Up,1=Left,2=Right,3=Down; 0=enabled, non-zero=disabled). Not dereferenced by this loop, passed through to fd2_repaint_settings_dialog_borders. Caller fd2_settings_menu_input_step holds it as int *pSlot_disable_arr.
params.reason: Descriptive p-prefixed pointer name matching the caller's declared int[4] slot-disable array; no address residue.

returns.semantics: The (remapped) BIOS scancode of the pressed key, read from key_input_mode after INT 16h. E0/Down(0x52)->Enter(0x1C), Right(0x53)->Esc(0x01); other scancodes returned unchanged. Caller fd2_settings_menu_input_step interprets 0x01=cancel, 0x39/0x1C=commit, 0x48/0x50/0x4B/0x4D=cursor move.

comment_original_issue: Original comment was accurate and concise but omitted the tick-rollover advance condition, the INT 16h read + scancode remap on exit, and the fact that both parameters are pass-through to fd2_repaint_settings_dialog_borders (the loop body never uses them directly).
